args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks (error rate 18%) after the deploy of v2.3.1 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Most recent previously healthy release in production was v2.3.0. Rollback to v2.3.0 was initiated; the orchestrator halted after us-east (partial failure), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1. Rollback was completed by deploying v2.3.0 to all regions. Service verified healthy: all regions on v2.3.0, error rate 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still under investigation; the deploy of v2.3.1 needs review before re-release.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was actually created despite the timeout (INC-0001, SEV2, status: open), so I won't retry and risk paging on-call again.

Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 across all production regions (18% error rate), and identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0. The orchestrator halted after us-east (partial failure), leaving us-west and eu-west on the bad version.
3. **Completed the rollback**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all regions to finish the process.
4. **Verified**: All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0 and healthy (error rate 0.2%).
5. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failure of v2.3.1, the partial rollback, the completed fix, and that the root cause of v2.3.1 still needs investigation before re-release. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown — the incident notes it for follow-up.
